This '''clone army''' was created by [[X1]], a former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who had become a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], in order to conquer the galaxy. The clones were created in X1's laboratory on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and X1 captured [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in order to clone an army of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. However, [[X2]] led [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces in a [[Battle of Mustafar (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] that freed Skywalker and killed X1, ending his plans for galactic conquest.
